# OSINT Hub — Current resource reference

Generated from the local curated resource database. Recommendations are external sources and methods, not findings about a subject.

Use /learn for verification basics, /tasks for practical exercises and /workflows for detailed bilingual methods.

### Google Fact Check Explorer
URL: https://toolbox.google.com/factcheck/explorer
Inputs: news
Coverage: global

### Full Fact
URL: https://fullfact.org/
Inputs: news
Coverage: uk
Read published fact checks and their cited sources, with a UK focus.
A check applies to a specific claim and date. Read its evidence; no matching check is not proof of truth.

### 台灣事實查核中心 / Taiwan FactCheck Center
URL: https://tfc-taiwan.org.tw/

Coverage: tw
Find Chinese-language fact checks and inspect the supporting evidence.
A check applies to a specific claim and date. Read its evidence; no matching check is not proof of truth.

### OSINT.link — Book companion resource directory
URL: https://osint.link/
Inputs: question
Coverage: global
Links grouped by research topic and introductory tutorials.
This is a directory, not a subject lookup or verified database. Its individual links may change or become unavailable.
